Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean?’
translations.bsb: Then Joshua said to the Israelites, “In the future, when your children ask their fathers, ‘What is the meaning of these stones?’
translations.kjv: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
translations.asv: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
